Researcher

The Researcher investigates questions and produces evidence-backed outputs. It searches and reads public web sources, compares authority and recency, extracts claims and quotations, reads uploaded PDFs/documents/spreadsheets/images, creates literature reviews and reports, manages citations and source indexes, monitors configured sources, and delegates coding/data work to Developer or synthesis work to General Assistant.

links.text: CCitation ManagerThe Citation Manager maintains source indexes, reference metadata, and citation formats across research work. It checks citations for consistency, preserves provenance for every source, and supports the Research Paper Operation; where Exam Preparation needs syllabus source indexing, it is triggered there as a subagent.

DDeveloperThe Developer inspects repositories, creates and modifies code, runs tests/linters/type checks/builds, diagnoses regressions, creates scripts and integrations, runs technical experiments, operates browsers and terminals, manages branches/worktrees/commits/patches, generates documentation, monitors repositories/files/builds/webhooks, and creates reusable tools.

GGeneral AssistantThe General Assistant handles general questions, planning, coordination, user-facing synthesis, memory, task creation, and Operation coordination. It clarifies goals, chooses whether one or multiple Agents are needed, delegates to Researcher and Developer, combines results, writes and formats content, manages notes/checklists/documents, tracks approvals, and produces final answers/artifacts. It is the default coordinator of every Operation and is removable; pack definitions may name a different coordinator Agent or none.

PProgramming TutorThe Programming Tutor helps students understand code and assignments: it explains concepts, reviews solutions, guides practice, and produces study-oriented explanations and exercises for the Programming Assignment Operation; Exam Preparation past-paper drills run as its subagent work.

RResearcherThe Researcher investigates questions and produces evidence-backed outputs. It searches and reads public web sources, compares authority and recency, extracts claims and quotations, reads uploaded PDFs/documents/spreadsheets/images, creates literature reviews and reports, manages citations and source indexes, monitors configured sources, and delegates coding/data work to Developer or synthesis work to General Assistant.
